title_vi: Học thuyết UNKNOWN — Không gian Chưa-biết Mở
nonclaims: UNKNOWN is not claimed here as a scientifically established physical field.
Unknown-unknown is not treated as known hidden content.
Persistent anomaly is not proof of a new ontology.
The doctrine does not claim the final nature of indeterminacy, consciousness, or the universe.
No finite taxonomy in this object is claimed to exhaust UNKNOWN.

relational_model.meaning: UNKNOWN is modeled as a dynamic relation, not merely a blank value slot.
relational_model.open_dimension_rule: The ellipsis is architectural: current dimensions are never treated as exhaustive.

core_propositions.text: UNKNOWN is not equivalent to falsehood.
UNKNOWN may contain structured information even when a precise value is absent.
UNKNOWN is not generally reducible to one missing scalar value.
The shape of an UNKNOWN depends on observer, model, context, access, representation, question and causal history.
Unknown-unknown can only be approached through indicators of missing structure; naming it does not reveal its content.
Persistent structured residual creates a missing-structure candidate, not automatic ontology promotion.
Knowledge growth can increase the frontier of recognized UNKNOWN.
core_propositions.formal: DeltaK>0 and DeltaU_recognized>0 may hold simultaneously

core_propositions.text: False-known can be more dangerous than declared UNKNOWN when consequential decisions depend on correction.
Some UNKNOWN carries option value, agency value, privacy value or creative value and should not be eliminated by default.
Cognitive systems can generate endogenous UNKNOWN through compression, abstraction, filtering, taxonomy, incentive and memory decay.
Epistemic diversity can reduce correlated blind spots; many agents with the same blind spot can amplify error.
Intelligence includes the capacity to remain coherent, corrigible and functional after model failure.
Future UNKNOWN may include not-yet-realized states rather than hidden present values.
UNKNOWN can have provenance, causal history and lineage.
UNKNOWN need not terminate in KNOWN; it may be reframed, become obsolete, close as a branch, reopen, or become contested.
Open-ended intelligence may co-evolve with the depth and structure of the UNKNOWN it can perceive and survive.

unknown_weight_heuristic.formula: UnknownWeight(U) ~= CausalCentrality * DecisionSensitivity * IrreversibilityExposure * PropagationDepth * ModelDependence
unknown_weight_heuristic.purpose: Prioritize UNKNOWN by downstream consequence rather than surface size.

grand_ending_relation.claim: UNKNOWN competence is modeled as part of epistemic survivability against low-generativity terminal convergence.

governance_rule: Detect fast; preserve carefully; test aggressively; commit slowly; keep provenance; never turn model limits into reality limits.
